title: Volumetric Counter-Punch Sculpture
discipline: Steel Punch-Cutting Mechanics · Counter-Punch Cold-Displacement · Tool Steel Metallurgy · 3D Negative Space
hypothesis: Can digital typography simulate the 3D metallurgical sculpture of steel punch-cutting, demonstrating that designing letterforms by driving three-dimensional negative counter-punches into tool steel creates intrinsically superior optical counter-space balance and family consistency compared to drawing flat outer vector contours?
